title: Guard a folder-named kit binding as the kit served and keep its pin
summary: A method binding written with a kit's folder is now guarded as the kit the resolver serves when kits share that folder: an exact id first, then a bundled kit, the lock's package entries and the IA home, so a bundled kit with no lock row of its own refuses with IA-CORE-KIT-NOT-INSTALLED instead of passing on another kit's row. A task's retained pin is found for such a binding.
